source: Ohio DNR, Original Natural Vegetation of Ohio (dataset 3135; Gordon 1966)
historical_reference_period: Time of earliest land surveys; source publication 1966
original_source_material: Robert B. Gordon, Natural Vegetation of Ohio at the Time of the Earliest Land Surveys
digitization_method: ODNR polygon digitization of published paper map for agency analysis, circa 2003
wetland_classes: Elm-Ash Swamp Forests; Freshwater Marshes and Fens; Sphagnum Peat Bogs; White Pine-Red Maple Swamp; Bottomland Hardwood
terms: Distributed as-is; ODNR disclaims warranties and fitness; user determines suitability
compatibility_notes: Primary Ohio candidate basis. Classes are ecological associations, not a named Great Black Swamp envelope.

source: Indiana DNR / Indiana Geographic Information Office, Presettlement Land Cover IDNR 2016
historical_reference_period: Layer metadata says circa 1820; source literature describes presettlement Indiana around statehood
original_source_material: Original land-survey records and modern county soil maps; Lindsey, Crankshaw, and Qadir 1965
map_scale: Not stated in current FeatureServer metadata
digitization_method: IDNR generalized polygon digitization published in 2016
wetland_classes: Wetlands (wetlands, marshes, swamps, bogs, including wet prairie)
spatial_precision: Generalized; source scale not stated in service metadata
terms: Public query service; detailed reuse terms not stated in layer metadata and should be confirmed before redistribution
compatibility_notes: Low-to-medium direct compatibility: Wetlands combines several Ohio classes; period and method differ. Do not seam or merge automatically.

source: Michigan Natural Features Inventory / Michigan DNR, Vegetation circa 1800
historical_reference_period: General Land Office surveys 1816-1856; digital interpretation published 1995
original_source_material: General Land Office survey notes and plats
map_scale: County display maps vary (for example Lenawee County 1:90,000); no single analytical scale stated on the landing page
digitization_method: MNFI interpretation and digital map production from GLO surveys
wetland_classes: Includes black ash swamp, cedar swamp, mixed conifer swamp, shrub swamp/emergent marsh and other detailed types
spatial_precision: Finer thematic detail than Ohio; accuracy limited by GLO interpretation and county map products
terms: Public interactive viewer and PDF maps; redistribution terms for underlying GIS should be confirmed with MNFI
compatibility_notes: Medium thematic compatibility after a documented crosswalk; different source period, scale, detail, and interpretation preclude automatic merge.
